name: CombatProgramBuilder
semantic_facts: build() rejects GameData/ResolvedActionCatalog identity mismatch before compiling (builder.rs:54-59)
trait_source and external_spell_policy are optional; absent catalogs make selected declarations fail closed downstream

name: compile_combat_program_with_sources (authority ordering)
semantic_facts: order: selected-owner audit -> attack-power conversion -> auras -> capacities -> cooldown plan -> program bindings -> fixed travel -> program structure (periodic schedules, definitions, dispel, reapplication audits) -> expiry drivers -> health thresholds -> resource thresholds -> action preventions -> pool plans -> passive flow plans -> execution plans -> absorb capacity -> actions -> cooldown modifiers -> stats -> modifiers/power cost -> threshold execution capacity -> resources compose -> aura ordinals -> execution layout

every compiled plan is moved into CompiledCombatProgram or finish_combat_program(stats); no compiled output is dropped (fixed travel is consumed through execution plans; health/resource thresholds, expiry drivers, periodic schedules stored)
aura ordinals are assigned after all aura consumers compile (compile.rs:162), and state-side AuraBindings consume those ordinals

name: compact handles
semantic_facts: u32 compact handles with u32::MAX sentinel for optional edge/slab handles; overflow maps to program_too_large
ProgramHandle/CastActivationHandle have no sentinel so u32::MAX is a valid index (no sentinel collision)

name: compile_capacities
semantic_facts: slab Vec capacity hints only (cold); undercount would only reallocate at compile time, not change semantics
StartRecoveryPlan built from every action's start-recovery category

name: program definitions (handles, formulas, operation definitions)
semantic_facts: immutable per-effect definitions (damage formula binding with mechanic, health leech f32 multiplier promoted to f64 at read, power burn/mana leech definitions carrying expected mana percent)
handles index program slabs; no runtime mutable state

name: execution layout
semantic_facts: per-program quote/aura/health/impact capacities, immediate depth, fixed travel seconds and node flags
CombatExecutionLayout sizes state scratch (quoted_costs, ExecutionScratch) at construction

name: execution planning graph (capacities by postorder)
semantic_facts: compile_execution_plans walks programs in postorder accumulating child periodic/deferred/absorb capacities with checked u32 adds (planning.rs:597-610)
capacity bound correctness is UNKNOWN (UNK-H-002) but no reachable fixture exceeded it

name: HasteProgram
semantic_facts: composes passive all-haste, passive melee auto-attack speed and active casting speed plans; None when all absent
white-only predicates (passive_all_only / melee-only) require the other two plans absent

name: CombatState construction
semantic_facts: white main hand and selected-package bindings validated on raw input first
actors canonicalized, then passive haste-all / maximum health / maximum resources applied once, then every index-bearing owner compiled against the canonical roster
baselines captured after passives (construction.rs:331-341)
random stream from input identity; now ZERO

name: CombatState reset topology
semantic_facts: reset_runtime order: actors restore -> start recovery -> cooldowns -> casts -> periodic -> modifiers -> health -> attacks -> white -> timing (restores haste channels on actors) -> auras -> resources (restore flow baseline, replan thresholds at ZERO) -> independent stacks -> absorbs -> now -> scratch
reset keeps identity (random.reset), reset_for_iteration assigns identity.stream()
does not model death cleanup (CSA-H-01)

name: ActorState / ActorBaseline
semantic_facts: resources sorted by ResourceType with duplicate/active-resource validation
commit_* mutators are the only health/resource writers
baseline restores resources, active resource and health (not haste/offensive power; see REJ-H-005)

name: CombatStateInput topology
semantic_facts: relations canonicalized; self/duplicate/conflicting/missing-actor relations rejected
self target implicit for every roster actor

name: CombatLayout
semantic_facts: immutable start-recovery and cooldown plans shared by state storage and quotes

name: CombatObservation death events
semantic_facts: ActorDied / WhiteMainHandDeath are observations only; no state owner reacts to them

name: Engine reset / iteration reset
semantic_facts: Engine reset forwards to CombatState and clears observations; rotation scratch cleared per evaluation
EngineProgram (combat program, rotation, field plan) immutable

name: crate public surface
semantic_facts: only CombatProgram/CombatState/CombatStateInput and binding value types are public; runtime owners are pub(crate), so all probes reach them only through construction/cast/advance/update_passive_resource_flow/reset
